name: 到期管家
description: Track due dates and Apple Reminders with system-language widgets, trailing-aligned compact details, and readable middle-truncated metadata.

localizedDescriptions.en: 2.3.5 aligns the small widget’s amount and note to its date edge, and keeps long medium/large metadata readable with native tightening and middle truncation.
localizedDescriptions.zh: 2.3.5 将小号金额与备注右侧对齐日期，并通过原生字距收紧和中间省略优化中、大号过长备注。
localizedDescriptions.zh-Hans: 2.3.5 将小号金额与备注右侧对齐日期，并通过原生字距收紧和中间省略优化中、大号过长备注。
localizedDescriptions.zh-Hant: 2.3.5 將小號金額與備註右側對齊日期，並透過原生字距收緊和中間省略優化中、大號過長備註。
